questions.q: What does ImagePadForOutpaint fill new pixels with?
questions.why: new_image starts as ones times 0.5, and your picture is copied in.

questions.q: You pad a 512 x 512 picture and set feathering 40, then use VAEEncodeForInpaint with grow_mask_by 6. How many of your pixels get repainted, counted from the join?
questions.why: Rounding keeps only the ramp above one half, 11 pixels, and growth adds 2. The lab's table says 13.

questions.q: You pad an 80 x 512 picture with feathering 40. What happens?
options: The feather is skipped, and you get a hard edge
questions.answer: The feather is skipped, and you get a hard edge
questions.why: The node needs feathering x 2 to be below both sides. 80 is not below 80.

questions.q: Which edges of your picture get a feather if you only pad the left?
questions.why: Each distance is only used if that side was padded. In the lab the far column and the top row stay at 0.

questions.q: Your padded picture is 644 wide. A VAE route crops it. To what?
questions.why: The width goes to (644 // 8) x 8, with the offset taken from the middle.
